actions.name: drive forward at 30 % without a distance

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if RLIGHT is above 75 %, drive forward at 30 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel without a line without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.

an obstacle is ahead at the front obstacle sensor

branches.outcome: the line tracker sees black: curve left
the line tracker does not see black: curve right
